newsitem.title: SPAIN: Retevision picks Lehman to manage privatisation.
newsitem.headline: Retevision picks Lehman to manage privatisation.

text.p: Spanish state telecommunications firm Retevision said on Friday it has chosen Lehman Brothers to manage its privatisation process.
Retevision is set to become Spain's second telecommunications operator after Telefonica.
A total of 10 investment banks were competing for the Retevision contract.
One of Lehman's first tasks will be to help in the evaluation process of the firm, Retevision said.
At least 51 percent of Retevision is to be privatised. The Spanish government has said that this may take place anytime after October.
